description: A micro AI agent for learning harness engineering: three-layer (core / transport / UI) Electron app with a pluggable tool system, event-sourced storage, and DSH-style context compaction.

features.name: Layered Architecture (core / transport / UI)
features.description: Business logic lives in core/, the UI only renders, and a launcher coordinator wires them together via a transport registry so clients can be swapped.
features.evidence: launcher.js selects UI from UIS registry (AGENT_UI) and starts transport (AGENT_TRANSPORT); core/index.js exports createCore()/handleCall(); README.md 'Architecture' section.

features.name: Pluggable Transport (http / ipc)
features.description: Core-to-UI communication is abstracted behind a transport registry; http is the default and ipc is an alternative, selected by AGENT_TRANSPORT.
features.evidence: core/transport.js registers createHttpTransport/createIpcTransport with DEFAULT='http'; core/transports/http.js and core/transports/ipc.js; launcher.js calls startTransport().

features.name: Electron Default UI
features.description: Electron client creates a BrowserWindow with a preload bridge; renderer is a standalone web app under ui/web. UI subprojects register in launcher.js.
features.evidence: ui/electron/main.js, preload.js, ui/electron/package.json; ui/web/index.html + app.js; launcher.js UIS map.

features.name: Agent Loop (unbounded turn/step)
features.description: One chat() call is one turn of repeating steps; each step is one model request, and the loop continues while the model returns tool_calls with no hardcoded step cap.
features.evidence: core/index.js chat() 'for (let r = 0; ; r++)' loop, terminates only on no tool_calls or TurnError; docs/behavior.md documents turn/step semantics.

features.name: bare-chat vs persisted session modes
features.description: Session-mode layer: core.chat() dispatches by an EXPLICIT ctx.mode === "bare" signal (sent by the UI's runBareChat) BEFORE choosing a loop engine; NOT inferred from !sessionId (there are legitimate no-sessionId callers that still need the tool loop). bare goes to core/bare-chat.js runBareChat — NOT a loop engine — with tools=[] hard-forced, per-request system prompt, in-memory history (bareHistory), no persistence, but still input/output translation and the linear termination/[turn]/turn-end contract. persisted selects a workspace, persists turns/steps/messages to the DB, supports tool calls, and chooses the engine (linear/node-graph) only in this branch via AGENT_LOOP_ENGINE.
features.evidence: core/index.js chat() dispatches ctx.mode==="bare" -> runBareChat() else _runLoop(); ui/web/app.js runBareChat passes mode:"bare"; core/bare-chat.js runBareChat(core, ctx); docs/behavior.md 'mode-selector' section; docs/agent-mode.md session-mode layer.

features.name: Streaming & non-streaming model responses
features.description: Core supports SSE streaming (delta tokens, reasoning_content, incremental tool_calls) and non-streaming JSON responses, chosen by settings.stream or per-call override.
features.evidence: core/index.js _stream() handles both stream and non-stream branches incl. tool_call accumulation and usage reporting; core/network/http/client.js postChatCompletions().

features.name: Provider / model configuration
features.description: Model providers, base URLs, API keys and model lists come from user/providers.json (not hardcoded); settings.json selects the active provider/model and supplies the default when none is given.
features.evidence: core/index.js readProvidersFile()/resolveProvider()/resolveDefaultFromProviders()/resolveProvider in chat(); user/providers.json; docs/roadmap.md 'model-provide' done via config.

features.name: System prompt assembly (session-first, ordered sections)
features.description: System prompt is assembled once on a session's first turn and frozen thereafter; sections are ordered by a fixed table and tool prompts are injected only for visible tools.
features.evidence: core/system-prompt.js assembleSystemPrompt()/DEFAULT_IDENTITY; core/index.js chat() systemIsNew branch; docs/system-prompt.md.

features.name: Settings & unified function dispatch
features.description: A single handleCall() dispatcher routes channel requests (chat, settings, permissions, providers, storage, fs, compact, approvals, planMode, etc.) to core methods, keeping transports thin.
features.evidence: core/index.js handleCall() switch with cases chat/settings/permissions/providers/storage/fs/compact/approval/answerQuestions/answerPlanReview/planMode/modelCapabilities; exports at file end.

features.name: Directory-based pluggable tool registry
features.description: Each tools/<name>/ subdir declares its interface via registry.json (name, description, parameters, type, entry, prompt, timeoutMs, defaultVisible); a loader scans and registers them at core startup.
features.evidence: core/tools/registry.js loadTools(); 20 tool dirs each with registry.json (read/write/edit/glob/grep/bash/ask_user_question/web_search/web_fetch/goals/todo/jobs/plan/builtins); docs/tool.md '工具注册机制'; README.md 'Tools'.

features.name: Tool validation, execution & result shaping
features.description: Tool calls are JSON-parsed and schema-validated before approval, executed via a normalized run() contract, and their results shaped into model-facing text plus UI/DB-only meta.
features.evidence: core/tools/executor.js validateToolArgs()/runTool(); core/tools/schema.js validateSchema(); core/tools/result.js errorResult()/normalizeResult(); core/index.js tool-call loop.

features.name: read — line-numbered file read
features.description: Read a UTF-8 text file and return line-numbered content, with optional offset/limit paging. Records a per-session file observation (present at mtime:size, or absent) that write/edit later depend on.
features.evidence: tools/read/registry.json (params file_path, offset, limit; prompt 'Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat'); tools/read/run.js; core/tools/fs-observe.js record().

features.name: write — create or replace file
features.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file. Enforces fs-observation-policy: an existing file must have been read first and the observed version (mtime:size) must still match, otherwise the write is refused.
features.evidence: tools/write/registry.json (params file_path, content); tools/write/run.js; core/tools/fs-observe.js assertVersion(); test/tools.test.js 'read/write/edit follow fs observation'.

features.name: edit — literal string replacement
features.description: Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing a literal old_string with new_string, optionally replace_all. Requires a prior present observation; refuses a stale observed version or a missing file.
features.evidence: tools/edit/registry.json (params file_path, old_string, new_string, replace_all); tools/edit/run.js; core/tools/fs-observe.js; test/tools.test.js 'write rejects a stale observed version'.

features.name: glob — file path discovery
features.description: Find files (not directories) matching a glob pattern, including hidden and ignored files, in modification-time order. Caps at 100 paths and spills the complete list to a reported file; concurrencySafe, 30s timeout.
features.evidence: tools/glob/registry.json (params pattern, path; timeoutMs 30000; concurrencySafe true); tools/glob/run.js; tools/lib/ripgrep.js; test/tools.test.js 'glob caps at 100 paths and spills the rest'.

features.name: grep — ripgrep content search
features.description: Search file contents with a ripgrep regex, returning line-numbered matches grouped by file. Caps at 250 matches and spills the rest; supports an include glob; concurrencySafe, 30s timeout.
features.evidence: tools/grep/registry.json (params pattern, path, include; timeoutMs 30000; concurrencySafe true); tools/grep/run.js; test/tools.test.js 'grep caps at 250 matches and spills the rest'.

features.name: bash — shell command execution
features.description: Execute a bash -c command in a fresh shell with optional workdir, returning stdout/stderr and an exit-code marker. 120s default timeout (hard cap 600s, kills the process group), each stream capped to last 64KB with full spill to a file, and an opt-in program/args command gate from user/bash-policy.json that fails closed to ask/deny. No sandbox is implemented.
features.evidence: tools/bash/registry.json (params description, command, timeoutMs, workdir; timeoutMs 120000); tools/bash/run.js (gate, truncation, timeout, DSH_* env vars); tools/bash/policy/; test/bash-integration.test.js 8 cases; AGENTS.md 'no sandbox'.

features.name: web_search — Tavily web search
features.description: Search the web via Tavily, merging up to four queries, and render an optional summary answer plus a list of source URLs. 30s timeout, concurrencySafe; results are marked untrusted and should be followed up with web_fetch.
features.evidence: tools/web_search/registry.json (params queries; timeoutMs 30000; concurrencySafe true); tools/web_search/run.js; tools/lib/web/{config,search,tavily,network,trust}.js; docs/tool.md 'P3 已实现'.

features.name: web_fetch — URL to bounded markdown
features.description: Fetch one HTTP(S) URL under the public-network policy and render the response as bounded markdown/text (HTML converted via turndown), with a 30s timeout. Returns statusCode/truncated in meta.
features.evidence: tools/web_fetch/registry.json (params url; timeoutMs 30000; concurrencySafe true); tools/web_fetch/run.js; tools/lib/web/{transport,render,policy,trust}.js; package.json turndown + @joplin/turndown-plugin-gfm.

features.name: ask_user_question — suspend for user input
features.description: Ask the user one or more concise questions for confirmation, a choice, or missing information. The turn pauses until the UI answers; in autonomous mode the request resolves without waiting.
features.evidence: tools/ask_user_question/registry.json (type interaction; params questions); tools/ask_user_question/run.js; core/index.js requestUserQuestion()/answerQuestions()/isAutonomous(); test/tools.test.js 'ask_user_question blocks until the UI answers'.

features.name: request_user_job — delegate real-world task to human
features.description: Delegate a task to the human user; the turn pauses until the user submits a free-text report via an interactive card. Returns the report plus a job_id for later recall via job_output / job_list.
features.evidence: tools/request_user_job/registry.json (type interaction; params description, title); tools/request_user_job/run.js; core/index.js requestUserJob()/answerUserJob(); schema.mjs user_jobs table; ui.md user-job-request.

features.name: job_output — read user job result/status
features.description: Fetch the result or current status of a user job by job_id: the user's report when completed, or a status line if still pending or killed. Requires an active session (reads exec.store directly).
features.evidence: tools/job_output/registry.json (type read; params job_id); tools/job_output/run.js reads store.run('userJob.get'); schema.mjs user_jobs table.

features.name: job_list — list session user jobs
features.description: List the user jobs delegated to the human for this session, each with job_id, status and a short (80-char) description snippet. Requires an active session (reads exec.store directly).
features.evidence: tools/job_list/registry.json (type read; no params); tools/job_list/run.js reads store.run('userJob.list', {session_id}); schema.mjs user_jobs table.

features.name: job_kill — cancel a pending user job
features.description: Cancel a pending user job by job_id. Completed or already-cancelled jobs cannot be killed; the current status is reported instead.
features.evidence: tools/job_kill/registry.json (type read; params job_id); tools/job_kill/run.js; core/index.js killUserJob(); schema.mjs user_jobs table.

features.name: create_goal — persisted session goal
features.description: Create a persisted goal with an optional max_goal_rounds cap, intended for long-running objectives. The registry describes automatic continuation rounds, but that driver is not implemented yet (tracked as the pending goal-auto-continue feature).
features.evidence: tools/create_goal/registry.json (type goal; params objective, max_goal_rounds); tools/create_goal/run.js; core/goals.js createGoalService().create() + header note; schema.mjs goals table.

features.name: get_goal — read current session goal
features.description: Read the current session goal, including the id and revision that update_goal requires.
features.evidence: tools/get_goal/registry.json (type goal; no params); tools/get_goal/run.js; core/goals.js get().

features.name: update_goal — mutate current goal
features.description: Update the current goal by goal_id + revision (optimistic concurrency) with actions edit/pause/resume/complete/blocked, optionally changing objective, max_goal_rounds or blocked_reason. State transitions and revision CAS are real; the DSH goal-round authority driver is not implemented, so the '3 consecutive rounds' rule is a prompt hint only.
features.evidence: tools/update_goal/registry.json (type goal; params goal_id, revision, action, objective, max_goal_rounds, blocked_reason); tools/update_goal/run.js; core/goals.js update() + header comment 'automatic continuation-round driver is not implemented yet'; test/tools.test.js goal service cases.

features.name: todo_write — replace task list
features.description: Record and update a task list to plan multi-step work and show progress: one todo per concrete step, kept in_progress while active, marked completed as done. The list is replaced on each call and reset at every turn start.
features.evidence: tools/todo_write/registry.json (type todo; params todos); tools/todo_write/run.js; core/todo-state.js reset(); core/index.js resets todo at turn start; test/tools.test.js todo_write cases.

features.name: exit_plan_mode — present plan for approval
features.description: Only available in plan mode. Presents a markdown plan for user review; approval exits plan mode, rejection keeps it active and returns the user's feedback in the tool result. Turn pauses on a plan-review event.
features.evidence: tools/exit_plan_mode/registry.json (type plan; params plan); tools/exit_plan_mode/run.js; core/plan-mode.js; core/index.js requestPlanReview()/answerPlanReview(); docs/tool.md 'P5 提前实现'; two test/tools.test.js plan-mode cases are stale.

features.name: calculator — arithmetic evaluation (hidden)
features.description: Evaluate an arithmetic expression containing only numbers and +-*/(). Hidden from the model by default (defaultVisible: false), available as an opt-in builtin.
features.evidence: tools/calculator/registry.json (type builtin; defaultVisible false; params expression); tools/calculator/run.js regex-whitelist + Function evaluation.

features.name: get_current_time — ISO8601 clock (hidden)
features.description: Return the current date and time as an ISO8601 string. Hidden from the model by default (defaultVisible: false), available as an opt-in builtin; takes no parameters.
features.evidence: tools/get_current_time/registry.json (type builtin; defaultVisible false; no params); tools/get_current_time/run.js Date().toISOString().

features.name: tools/lib shared helpers (ripgrep / web)
features.description: Shared implementation library for tools: a ripgrep wrapper for glob/grep, and a web subsystem (config, transport, network policy, trust, Tavily client, search, HTML rendering) backing web_search/web_fetch.
features.evidence: tools/lib/ripgrep.js; tools/lib/web/{config,errors,network,policy,render,search,tavily,transport,trust}.js.

features.name: Three-level tool permission gate
features.description: Per-tool allow/ask/deny from user/permissions.json; malformed or missing config fails closed to 'ask'. ask suspends the turn until the user approves via an approval-request event.
features.evidence: core/permissions.js readPermissions()/permissionFor() with LEVELS set and fallback 'ask'; core/index.js requestApproval()/approve() and tool-call decision branch; user/permissions.json.

features.name: Fine-grained fs path policy for write/edit
features.description: write/edit permissions are narrowed or widened by path-glob rules in user/fs-policy.json; deny wins, first match otherwise, and a broken policy file is ignored.
features.evidence: core/fs-policy.js readFsPolicy()/resolveFsPermission(); core/index.js resolveFsPermission() call for write/edit; user/fs-policy.json; docs/tool.md.

features.name: Event-sourced session storage (pgmicro)
features.description: Sessions, turns, steps, messages, calls and compaction events are stored in a single-file pgmicro DB; the model-visible history is a replayed surface projection, with log rows never rewritten.
features.evidence: core/storage/store.mjs Store class with session.surface/compaction.append/message.add/turn.create/step.create; core/storage/schema.mjs tables incl. session_events, tool_result_prunes, token_anchors, user_jobs; docs/event-sourcing.md; docs/context-compact.md.

features.name: Workspace folder resolution
features.description: Tool cwd is derived from the session's workspace folder; relative folder names (from the web folder picker) are resolved heuristically against cwd/home/parent, falling back to process.cwd().
features.evidence: core/index.js workspaceFolderCandidates()/resolveWorkspaceFolder()/_resolveCwd(); docs/system-prompt.md {{cwd}} variable description.

features.name: DSH-style context compaction (/compact)
features.description: Manual /compact condenses older history into one checkpoint message; automatic pressure compaction runs before each model request at 80% of the window, pruning oversized tool results first.
features.evidence: core/compaction.js (thresholds, checkpoint framing, boundary selection, overflow detection); core/index.js compactSession()/_maybeCompactStep()/_runCompaction()/_pruneToolResults(); docs/context-compact.md; README.md 'Context compaction'; docs/roadmap.md done.

features.name: Context-overflow recovery
features.description: When a model request fails due to context overflow, the core attempts a prune/summarize recovery pass and retries once before failing the turn.
features.evidence: core/index.js chat() overflow retry loop calling _maybeCompactStep({trigger:'context-overflow'}); core/compaction.js isContextOverflowError(); docs/context-compact.md.

features.name: Token metering & usage anchors
features.description: Standardizes provider usage (incl. cached tokens), records per-request usage anchors, and drives the UI context/token indicators.
features.evidence: core/token-meter.js normalizeUsage()/measure()/anchorFrom(); core/index.js _emitUsage()/_recordTokenAnchor(); schema.mjs token_anchors table; docs/context-compact.md.

features.name: Chinese/English auto-translation
features.description: Chinese user input is translated to English before reaching the model; English assistant answers are translated to Chinese for display only. Translations are never persisted, with independent input/output failure policies and timeouts.
features.evidence: core/translation.js resolveTranslateConfig()/shouldTranslateUser()/shouldTranslateAssistant()/translateText(); core/index.js translation start/done/error events in chat(); docs/translate.md; docs/roadmap.md 'auto-translate MVP (done)'.

features.name: Plan mode & exit_plan_mode
features.description: plan-mode activity puts a session into plan mode; a request-scoped policy is injected each step, and exit_plan_mode shows a markdown plan and blocks until the user approves or gives feedback.
features.evidence: core/plan-mode.js setActive()/isActive()/POLICY; tools/exit_plan_mode registry; core/index.js chat() sets planMode from activity==='plan-mode', requestPlanReview()/answerPlanReview()/setPlanMode(); docs/tool.md 'P5 已提前实现 plan 模式'; docs/agent-mode.md. Two test/tools.test.js plan-mode cases are stale against this activity-driven behavior.

features.name: Agent mode (presence / autonomy / activity)
features.description: Three orthogonal axes: presence (in/out), autonomy (supervised/autonomous, where autonomous auto-denies all ask calls), and activity (9 values: plan-mode/intent-recog/goal-mode/build-code/discuss-doc/research/review-proj/human-learn/diagnose, default research). plan-mode is the only activity that drives the built-in plan-mode mechanism (POLICY injection + exit_plan_mode); the other activities are placeholder enums the model interprets from context. bare-chat is no longer an activity value but a separate session mode (bare/persisted) dispatched by an explicit ctx.mode==="bare" signal in core.chat() (not inferred from !sessionId).
features.evidence: docs/agent-mode.md (9-value activity enum + session-mode layer + per-activity implementation status); core/index.js isAutonomous() checks in requestApproval()/requestUserQuestion()/requestUserJob() and chat() session-mode dispatch; ui.md presence-mode-switch/autonomy-mode-switch/activity-indicator (9 values); composer permission-selector feedback.

features.name: Human-in-the-loop interaction tools
features.description: ask_user_question, request_user_job (+ job_list / job_output / job_kill) suspend the turn and emit UI cards; in autonomous mode they resolve without waiting.
features.evidence: tools/ask_user_question, tools/request_user_job, tools/job_list, tools/job_output, tools/job_kill registries; core/index.js requestUserQuestion()/answerQuestions()/requestUserJob()/answerUserJob()/killUserJob(); schema.mjs user_jobs table; ui.md ask-user-prompt/user-job-request.

features.name: Goal & todo tools
features.description: create_goal / get_goal / update_goal (goal service) and todo_write project task state into the session.
features.evidence: core/goals.js createGoalService(); core/todo-state.js reset(); tools/create_goal, get_goal, update_goal, todo_write registries; schema.mjs goals table; docs/tool.md 'P2 已实现'.

features.name: @ reference injection (file / session)
features.description: UI references are resolved into context blocks injected before the question: local file contents (size-capped) or an excerpt of a historical session trajectory.
features.evidence: core/index.js _resolveReferences(); ui.md ref-btn/ref-chips; docs/data-struct.md session.trajectory storage op.

features.name: Reasoning effort selector
features.description: Effort levels (off/low/medium/high) map to provider fields (thinking.disabled / reasoning_effort); modelCapabilities resolves supported levels from a local providers.json cache or a live /models fetch.
features.evidence: core/index.js _stream() effort mapping, modelCapabilities(), fetchProviderModels(); ui.md model-effort-selector/effort-selector; core/network/http/client.js fetchModels().

features.name: LLM network capture (nettrack)
features.description: All chat/completions and /models requests are teed to structured + raw JSON capture files under log/network/track/, with sensitive headers redacted and a one-line stdout summary per call.
features.evidence: core/network/http/client.js postChatCompletions()/fetchModels()/trackCapture(); core/network/http/tracker.js (NETTRACK/NETTRACK_QUIET, data/raw trees, redactHeaders); docs/log.md; docs/http.md.

features.name: Web UI shell & session management
features.description: Renderer UI with thread-sidebar (workspaces/sessions tree), chat viewport, trajectory tab, composer, and modals for settings/permissions/models, described by a layout-tree-first spec.
features.evidence: ui/web/app.js, ui/web/api.js, ui/web/settings.js, ui/web/permissions.js, ui/web/models.js, ui/web/markdown.js, ui/web/styles.css; docs/ui.md layout tree and name table.

features.name: Automated test suite (node --test)
features.description: 63 tests across tools, bash integration and compaction cover registry visibility, fs observation, gate verdicts, permission fail-closed, surface replay, checkpoint framing and token anchors. 61 pass; 2 plan-mode tests are stale (they set plan-mode state directly, while chat() now derives it from activity).
features.evidence: test/tools.test.js, test/bash-integration.test.js, test/compaction.test.js; package.json 'test': 'node --test test/*.test.js'; npm test => tests 63 / pass 61 / fail 2.

features.name: Session save / resume
features.description: Planned: save and resume sessions across restarts.
features.evidence: docs/roadmap.md '## session-save' (no code under core/ or tools/ implements it).

features.name: Skill system
features.description: Planned: a skill layer; a skills table exists in schema but no runtime implementation.
features.evidence: docs/roadmap.md '## skill'; core/storage/schema.mjs defines skills / tool_skills tables but no skill loader exists.

features.name: Plugin system
features.description: Planned: pluggable plugin architecture beyond the directory-based tool registry.
features.evidence: docs/roadmap.md '## plugin-system'; no plugin directory or loader in core/.

features.name: Subagents
features.description: Planned: sub-agent execution; UI reserves sub-agent-tree/agent-trace-node nodes but no runtime exists.
features.evidence: docs/roadmap.md '## subagents'; ui.md lists sub-agent-tree / agent-trace-node layout nodes only.

features.name: Standalone shell tool
features.description: Planned: a dedicated shell feature distinct from the existing bash tool.
features.evidence: docs/roadmap.md '## shell'; no shell tool directory under tools/.

features.name: Goal auto-continue turns
features.description: Planned: goals automatically drive the agent loop to continue working, rather than being passive records.
features.evidence: docs/tool.md 'P2 已实现 ... goal 自动续轮待做'; core/goals.js currently only provides CRUD service.
